records.title: ICE worksite enforcement raid at HL-GA battery plant (Hyundai/LG Energy Solution JV)
records.event_summary: DHS/ICE conducted its largest-ever single-site worksite enforcement operation at the HL-GA battery plant site, detaining approximately 475 workers (300+ South Korean nationals), most performing specialized equipment installation/commissioning work.
records.affected_entity: HL-GA Battery Company LLC (Hyundai Motor Group + LG Energy Solution)

records.title: Micron Clay, NY megafab construction delayed 2-3 years
records.event_summary: Micron's Final Environmental Impact Statement disclosed construction of the first Clay fab would be delayed; Onondaga County Executive Ryan McMahon attributed it to 'longer construction cycles and labor shortages'.

records.title: Texas Winter Storm Uri forces Samsung Austin fab offline
records.event_summary: Severe winter storm Uri caused a Texas grid emergency; Austin Energy forced an emergency shutdown of major electricity users, including Samsung's Austin semiconductor fab, to preserve power for homes and hospitals.

records.title: Rivian Georgia EV plant construction paused for capital allocation
records.event_summary: Rivian paused construction of its $5B Georgia EV plant to conserve capital, shifting planned R2 model production to its existing Normal, Illinois plant instead.

records.title: Fire at Renesas Naka Factory (N3 building, 300mm automotive-chip line)
records.event_summary: A fire broke out at 02:47 JST in the N3 building (300mm wafer line) of Renesas' Naka Factory, extinguished by 08:12 JST the same day; overcurrent ignition in plating equipment damaged ~2% of the fab's manufacturing equipment.

records.title: TSMC Arizona Fab 1 N4 production delay (labor shortage)
records.event_summary: TSMC announced it would delay N4-process chip production at its first Arizona fab from a late-2024 target to 2025, citing a shortage of skilled specialized construction/installation labor.

records.title: GM North American plants paused by global semiconductor shortage (April 2021 wave)
records.event_summary: The global semiconductor shortage forced GM to pause production at Fort Wayne (IN), Silao (Mexico), and Wentzville (MO) assembly plants; GM cited 'continued parts shortages caused by semiconductor supply constraints'.

records.title: Ford Kansas City Assembly plant paused by semiconductor shortage
records.event_summary: Ford's Kansas City Assembly Plant halted F-150 and Transit van production for two weeks starting May 17, 2021, and again in July 2021, due to the global semiconductor shortage.

records.title: Ford Saarlouis (Germany) Focus plant idled by semiconductor shortage
records.event_summary: Ford idled its Saarlouis, Germany plant (Ford Focus production, ~6,200 workers) from January 18 to February 19, 2021 due to the global semiconductor shortage.

records.title: VinFast Chatham County, NC EV plant stalls and is terminated by the state
records.event_summary: VinFast's Chatham County 'Moncure megasite' EV plant, promised in March 2022 (7,500 jobs, 2024 production start), stalled after 2023 site clearing; the county terminated its incentive agreement and the state sued to reclaim the site in 2026.

records.title: CATL Debrecen, Hungary battery plant trial-production delay
records.event_summary: CATL's Debrecen cell-production lines, originally targeting production operations by early 2026 per S&P Global, only began trial production on 2026-09-22, after a nickel-dust occupational-safety suspension and Hungary's withdrawal of streamlined 'key investment project' permitting.

records.title: Intel Ohio One fabs repeatedly delayed (2025 target to ~2030-2031)
records.event_summary: Intel's Ohio One fabs, originally targeted to begin production in 2025 when the $28B investment was announced in 2022, were restated (per Intel's own newsroom) to Mod 1 operations 2030-2031 and Mod 2 operations 2032, citing CHIPS Act funding uncertainty and market conditions.

records.title: Ford BlueOval City electric-pickup program cancelled, replaced by gas-truck program
records.event_summary: After delaying its electric-pickup program at BlueOval City from 2025 to 2027 (Aug 2024), Ford scrapped the electric pickup entirely in December 2025, renaming the site 'Tennessee Truck Plant' and retargeting gas-powered truck production for 2029.
records.affected_entity: Ford Motor Company (BlueOval SK JV with SK On)

records.title: TSMC Arizona Fab 2 timeline pushed to 2027/2028
records.event_summary: TSMC pushed back its second Arizona fab's production timeline from 2026 to 2027 or 2028, citing continued skilled-labor shortages and difficulty securing US government (CHIPS Act) funding. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified in STEP 2/2.5.]

records.title: Samsung Foundry Taylor, TX fab repeatedly delayed on yield/customer issues
records.event_summary: Samsung repeatedly delayed mass production at its Taylor, TX fab (2H2024 to 2025 to 2H2026 to early 2027), citing lower-than-expected 3nm/GAA yields and insufficient customer commitments. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified in STEP 2/2.5.]

records.title: Panasonic De Soto, KS battery plant full-production delay
records.event_summary: Panasonic delayed full production at its De Soto, KS battery plant (originally targeted March 2027) citing declining EV sales and the US policy change eliminating EV tax credits effective 2025-09-30. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified in STEP 2/2.5.]

records.title: Samsung SDI Göd, Hungary plant loses streamlined permitting exemption
records.event_summary: Samsung SDI's Göd, Hungary plant was named (alongside SK On's Ivancsa site) as now subject to Hungary's ordinary permitting regime after the government withdrew the 'key investment project' exemption; the plant has also faced long-running local complaints about groundwater contamination, noise, and dust. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified; no project-specific schedule impact found.]

records.title: Northvolt Canada (Quebec) plant possible schedule slip amid parent bankruptcy
records.event_summary: Following financial trouble at parent company Northvolt (which later filed for bankruptcy protection for part of its Swedish operations), Northvolt's Canadian battery-plant construction project was reported as possibly facing a schedule slip 'of up to 18 months' -- an explicitly hedged, unconfirmed estimate. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified in STEP 2/2.5.]

records.title: China rare-earth export controls disrupt global automotive supply chains
records.event_summary: China's April 2025 export controls on medium/heavy rare earths and rare-earth magnets, tightened further in October 2025, disrupted global automotive supply chains; industry groups reported production delays and export-license waits of roughly 8-12 weeks, industry-wide rather than tied to one named project. [STEP1-only: not independently re-verified in STEP 2/2.5.]
